blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Pitt Meadows total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Mid Meadows Condos and Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: Mid Meadows has zero verified apartment-condo buildings; every attached home here is a townhome or duplex on the Bonson Road corridor.

Mid Meadows is the board name for Bonson Road south of the CPKC rail line and Hammond Road, north of the Fraser River dike, between Harris Road west and the Maple Ridge boundary east; the City's own labels for the same ground are North Bonson, South Bonson and Osprey Village.

blocks.text: Mid Meadows Condos and Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: Nature's Walk is the cluster's developer-confirmed complex, described by Onni Group as townhomes and duplexes by Osprey Village.

blocks.text: Mid Meadows Condos and Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Building within seven metres of the Fraser River dike toe on a Bonson Road lot needs a permit under Drainage Bylaw No. 2266, 2007, which matters for fences and additions in dike-adjacent complexes like Shoreline at 19452 Fraser Way.

blocks.text: Mid Meadows Condos and Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Osprey Village's shops and the South Bonson Community Centre at 10932 Barnston View Road are the commercial centre for the whole Bonson corridor, not just the village pocket.
Edith McDermott Elementary at 12178 Bonson Road carries the Bonson name in its address but stands in the North Bonson stretch, a drive from Fraser Way.
The dike top is the neighbourhood's main trail and its flood structure at the same time; Shoreline Park at 51 Bonson Road sits on it.
Bonson by Mosaic at 19696 Hammond Road is not an Osprey Village complex despite the shared Bonson name — it stands on Hammond Road at the corridor's north edge.

blocks.text: Mid Meadows Condos and Townhomes: costs and taxes

items.t: 3047, 2026 general and drainage rates apply to every Fraser Way strata lot.
The Speculation and Vacancy Tax applies in Pitt Meadows, including to a vacant Osprey Village townhome.

blocks.text: Mid Meadows Condos and Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Fraser Way lots sit behind the Fraser River dike in the urban floodplain: Bylaw No. 2384, 2008 Schedule B sets the 5.15-metre designated flood level that governs flood construction levels here. Designation and Construction Control Bylaw No. 2384, 2008 - Consolidated.pdf
Dike setbacks under Drainage Bylaw No. 2266, 2007 (seven metres from the dike toe) can limit additions in the dike-adjacent complexes.
East of Bonson Road the urban corridor meets Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) farm parcels; confirm the ALR edge for any lot backing onto farmland on the City OCP maps.

blocks.text: Mid Meadows home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

27 condos sold in Mid Meadows with a median price of $561,000 (the middle half sold between $493,750 and $601,500), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 97.2% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $574 per square foot, a median year built of 2014 and a median strata fee of $462 a month. 16 townhomes sold in Mid Meadows with a median price of $667,500 (the middle half sold between $616,375 and $695,250), taking a median of 20 days to sell at 98.1% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $463 per square foot, a median year built of 1996 and a median strata fee of $387 a month.

faq.a: The complex, address and strata are identical either way — search both labels so no Osprey Village home is missed.
faq.q: Why does my Osprey Village listing say South Meadows if this page says Mid Meadows?

faq.a: Shoreline at 19452 Fraser Way stands at the Fraser River edge of Osprey Village, behind the dike, with the dike-top trail at Shoreline Park as its waterfront. Homes are not on unprotected riverbank: the dike and the City's floodplain bylaw sit between the complex and the river. Check the lot's flood construction level covenant and the strata's flood insurance in the Form B package. Designation and Construction Control Bylaw No. 2384, 2008 - Consolidated.pdf
faq.q: Is Shoreline actually on the water?

faq.a: No school building stands in Osprey Village, so catchment is an address lookup, not a walk-to-school assumption. The district list places Edith McDermott Elementary at 12178 Bonson Road and Davie Jones Elementary at 12030 Blakely Road as the city's Bonson-side elementary schools, with Pitt Meadows Secondary at 19438 116B Avenue for grades 8 to 12. Run the exact Barnston View Road address in the School District 42 locator before writing subjects.
faq.q: Which school serves Barnston View Road?

faq.a: Use the 719/722 circular service, which loops Bonson Road and Fraser Way to Meadowtown, Pitt Meadows Station and Maple Meadows Station for the West Coast Express. There is no station on Bonson Road itself, and route 701 on Hammond Road is the north-edge alternative.
